description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of Recall@50 and NDCG@50 metrics for two different methods, labeled as "Ours" and "ReFICR," across five different categories or conditions, represented by the numbers 1 through 5 on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled with these numbers, indicating a categorical or sequential variable, and the y-axis is labeled with two metrics: Recall@50 and NDCG@50. The Recall@50 metric is represented by a solid green line with circle markers, while the NDCG@50 metric is represented by a dashed blue line with square markers. The Recall@50 values for "Ours" start at approximately 0.35 and increase to just below 0.55, showing a steady upward trend. The NDCG@50 values for "Ours" begin at around 0.16 and rise to just above 0.19, also indicating a gradual increase. The "ReFICR" method, represented by a dotted green line and a dotted blue line, shows a Recall@50 value that remains constant at approximately 0.30 and an NDCG@50 value that is consistently around 0.15. The plot does not provide any additional context or information about the nature of the categories or the significance of the differences between the two methods.
